pin-red.$description: Pin Red — Red supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ink-plum.$description: Ink Plum — Primary text, logo wordmark, filled dark buttons — a warm near-black that reads softer than pure #000

gallery-white.$description: Gallery White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark fills, search field background

fog-gray.$description: Fog Gray — Secondary text, nav labels, icon strokes at rest, helper copy

stone-gray.$description: Stone Gray — Input placeholders, input borders, disabled hairlines

linen.$description: Linen — Subtle section bands, ghost button borders, soft surface tint for alternating blocks

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Dark supporting neutral for text, icons, and strong contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

halo-yellow.$description: Halo Yellow — Highlight wash behind emphasis moments, sticker-style accent in illustrated cards

ember-coral.$description: Ember Coral — Decorative image accent, filter chip color, illustrated card warm fill

lavender-veil.$description: Lavender Veil — Decorative image accent, highlighted word in headlines, illustrated card cool fill — the secondary brand color that softens the red

link-cobalt.$description: Link Cobalt — Inline link text, focusable content links

pin-sans.$description: Sole typeface for the entire system — nav, body, buttons, headlines, display. Geometric humanist sans with a tall x-height and open apertures.
